name: Statsig
summary: Statsig bundles feature gates with experimentation and analytics. Flag and config checks are unlimited on every plan, and pricing depends on events. Developer is free with 2 million events a month, and Pro costs $150 a month with 5 million events.

facts.text: Each gate rule has a Split % setting that sets the share of matching users who pass the check.
Above 2 million events on Developer, gate and config targeting keep working but Metric Lift computations stop.
Pro overage is $0.05 per additional 1K events, billed on the following month's invoice, and each Pro subscription covers one project.
Server SDKs cover Node.js, Java, Python, Go, Ruby, C#, PHP, C++ and Rust.

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: No credit card required. 2,000,000 events a month. The page shows $ without naming a currency

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Charged at the start of each monthly cycle. 5,000,000 events included. The page shows $ without naming a currency

hiddenCosts: Pro events above 5 million cost $0.05 per additional 1K.
